name: Cooking Disaster OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-18: Dacilane Academy's Delightful Disaster
description: Skillet sputter and pots threaten to boil over, splashing their contents onto careless cooks or kitchen counters. The counters are covered with small dishes ready to add, along with 3 heavy cookbooks and a healthy coating of flour.
disable: cooking-lore|dc:14 (trained) or DC 17 Crafting to add the proper ingredients to finish the dish. DC 17 Diplomacy or DC 17 Occultism to communicate with students when to stir or adjust the heat on a dish. Each disable attempt requires two actions, and three successful checks are required to disable the hazard.
reset: The trap deactivates after 1 minute, destroying all of the food. If left untouched, it resets automatically in 24 hours.
routine: (3 actions) The trap uses each of its actions to make a splatter attack against a random creature in the kitchen. The trap never targets a student, as they are out of phase with it. For every successful disable attempt on the trap, it loses an action.

generalAbilities.name: Bubble Over
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the room

Effect The hazard rolls initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Revolting Mixture
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature fails an attempt to Disarm the trap

Effect The incorrect execution of the recipe releases a nauseating odor. The triggering creature must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Sickened 1.
